verdict.rationale: Spline's automations (events/actions, webhooks, Real-time API) live inside scene files, and file-level Version History lets you preview saved versions, track changes, recover previous file states, and manually save versions. That covers versioning and rollback only indirectly, through whole-file snapshots rather than automation-specific controls. Missing for 10: automation-level versioning, diff/review of changes to interaction logic, granular rollback of individual automations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
